description: Read-only. The workspace's custom link domains (e.g. links.hilltop.example) with each one's status (pending_dns until the DNS records are in place, then live; verified once ownership is proven) and the exact DNS records to add. Also says whether custom domains are switched on and allowed on this plan (Scale and Enterprise) and the limit. Use it for "is my domain set up yet".
name: list_domains
title: List custom domains
